description: Aparthotel at the end of Passage du Prado, 18 Boulevard Saint-Denis, with self check-in via key box. Living room with double sofa bed, 4K TV and table for 4. Large, fully equipped kitchen with microwave. Room with double storage bed and single bunk bed. En suite bathroom with heated towel rail. Bed linen, towels, soap, shampoo, shower gel, washing-up liquid and toilet paper are provided. – hotel-type listing

enrichment.summary: This is described as an aparthotel. The room has a double storage bed and a single bunk bed, and the living room has a double sofa bed. The advertised total of four beds does not match that description; only the two non-sofa physical beds are countable from the layout. There is one ensuite bathroom and a kitchen.
